prompt_en: Photorealistic full-length field-fashion documentary: a pre-dawn high-altitude astronomy scene built around an Andean poncho silhouette above a cloud inversion. The subject is the same adult woman shown in the supplied portrait reference. Her facial structure, eye aperture and spacing, nose, lips, jawline, adult age, and long dark hair remain faithfully matched to that reference. She wears a handwoven rectangular poncho with a central neck slit, broad front and back panels dropping from both shoulders. One central neck opening anchors the poncho; broad front and back panels drop from both shoulders; the sides remain open around the arms; woven bands continue coherently across the panels; hand-finished lower edges remain visible. She braces a wind-loosened field notebook against a telescope case as the poncho spreads in the crosswind. A gust lifts one free side edge around her forearm while separating the rear panel behind the front panel. Use a low full-body 4:5 portrait frame with the complete hem and both side edges isolated against the cloud inversion. Raking cold dawn light catches the opening, yarn relief, and finished hem.
